Add the NassWallet (nw.iq) payment gateway driver:

- charge via initTransaction -> hosted checkout-portal redirect URL
- status check via checkTransaction (handles both documented response
  shapes: flat transactionStatus and rich TransactionHistoryList)
- unsigned merchant callback re-verified server-to-server via
  checkTransaction; only the InitTransactionId is read from the callback

NassWallet authenticates with a static Basic token plus a per-merchant
bearer token cached until accessTokenExpiry. Outcome is keyed off the
body responseCode (errCode is "1" even on success). Credentials are read
from injected config, keeping the driver Octane-safe and multi-tenant.

Webhook routing gains a payments/webhooks/{gateway}/callback alias —
NassWallet appends /callback to the merchant callback URL." class="Link--secondary" href="/ShahramMebashar/parakit/commit/2ab80dc4bcc5420982a5fd83c391db388cdf37e4">feat(nasswallet): hosted-portal <blockquote>
<p dir="auto">پارەکیت — The payment kit for Kurdistan and Iraq, Laravel-native.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/ShahramMebashar/parakit/actions/workflows/ci.yml"><img src="https://github.com/ShahramMebashar/parakit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg" alt="CI" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="/ShahramMebashar/parakit/blob/main/LICENSE"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/fdf2982b9f5d7489dcf44570e714e3a15fce6253e0cc6b5aa61a075aac2ff71b/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f4c6963656e73652d4d49542d79656c6c6f772e737667" alt="License: MIT" data-canonical-src="https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">Take payments from Iraqi and Kurdish customers in a Laravel app — <strong>FIB</strong>, <strong>ZainCash</strong>, <strong>Nass Pay</strong>, <strong>Nass Wallet</strong>, <strong>FastPay</strong>, <strong>QiCard</strong> — with idempotent webhooks, retry & circuit-breaker, redacted logging, a sweeper for lost webhooks, and three localised UIs (en/ar/ckb) out of the box.</p>
<p dir="auto"><code>composer require</code> → first sandbox charge in under 15 minutes. That's the goal.</p>
<hr>

<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Froshly</span>\<span class="pl-v">Parakit</span>\<span class="pl-v">Facades</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Payment</span>;
<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Froshly</span>\<span class="pl-v">Parakit</span>\<span class="pl-v">Enums</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Currency</span>;

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span> = Payment::<span class="pl-en">for</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">driver</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">fib</span>'</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">amount</span>(<span class="pl-c1">5000</span>, Currency::<span class="pl-c1">IQD</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">description</span>(<span class="pl-s">"<span class="pl-s">Order #</span>{<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>-><span class="pl-c1">id</span>}"</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">idempotencyKey</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>-><span class="pl-c1">id</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">charge</span>();

<span class="pl-k">if</span> (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span>-><span class="pl-en">failed</span>()) {
    <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-en">back</span>()-><span class="pl-en">with</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">error</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span>-><span class="pl-c1">error</span>-><span class="pl-en">message</span>(<span class="pl-en">app</span>()-><span class="pl-en">getLocale</span>()));
}

<span class="pl-c">// FIB returns a QR + readable code + deep link.</span>
<span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-en">view</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">checkout.fib</span>'</span>, [
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">qrCode</span>'</span>       => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span>-><span class="pl-c1">qrCode</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">readableCode</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span>-><span class="pl-c1">readableCode</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">deepLink</span>'</span>     => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span>-><span class="pl-c1">deepLink</span>,
]);</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="use Froshly\Parakit\Facades\Payment;
use Froshly\Parakit\Enums\Currency;

$response = Payment::for($order)
    ->driver('fib')
    ->amount(5000, Currency::IQD)
    ->description("Order #{$order->id}")
    ->idempotencyKey($order->id)
    ->charge();

if ($response->failed()) {
    return back()->with('error', $response->error->message(app()->getLocale()));
}

// FIB returns a QR + readable code + deep link.
return view('checkout.fib', [
    'qrCode'       => $response->qrCode,
    'readableCode' => $response->readableCode,
    'deepLink'     => $response->deepLink,
]);" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What you get for free</h2><a id="user-content-what-you-get-for-free" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What you get for free" href="#what-you-get-for-free"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<markdown-accessiblity-table data-catalyst=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Concern</th>
<th>Mechanism</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>Idempotency</strong></td>
<td><code>charge()</code> with the same <code>idempotencyKey</code> returns a cached response for 24h. DB unique index on <code>(gateway, event_id)</code> makes webhook delivery race-safe.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Retries</strong></td>
<td>Exponential backoff + jitter on transient gateway failures. Never on 4xx, never without an idempotency key.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Circuit breaker</strong></td>
<td>Per-gateway. Fails fast after N failures, auto-recovers after cooldown.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>State machine</strong></td>
<td>Illegal status transitions (e.g. <code>Paid → Pending</code>) throw and are logged — no double-fulfillment.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Webhook replay protection</strong></td>
<td>Rejects webhooks older than <code>parakit.webhooks.tolerance_seconds</code>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Lost-webhook recovery</strong></td>
<td><code>parakit:transactions:sweep-pending</code> polls status for stale pending transactions every 5 minutes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Redacted logging</strong></td>
<td>Request/response written to <code>payment_logs</code> with secrets redacted by configured key names + Luhn-gated PAN regex.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Correlation IDs</strong></td>
<td>One ULID traces a payment across <code>charge → webhook → status → refund</code>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Translations</strong></td>
<td>en / ar / ckb shipped; publish with <code>php artisan vendor:publish --tag=parakit-lang</code>.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<hr>

<p dir="auto">Turn any transaction into a branded PDF receipt — no gateway involved, it reads
the stored <code>payment_transactions</code> row.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Froshly</span>\<span class="pl-v">Parakit</span>\<span class="pl-v">Facades</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Receipt</span>;

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>transaction</span> = PaymentTransaction::<span class="pl-en">where</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">reference</span>'</span>, <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>-><span class="pl-c1">id</span>)-><span class="pl-en">firstOrFail</span>();

<span class="pl-k">return</span> Receipt::<span class="pl-en">for</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>transaction</span>)
    -><span class="pl-en">template</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">modern</span>'</span>)                 <span class="pl-c">// modern (default) · classic · minimal</span>
    -><span class="pl-en">customer</span>([
        <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">name</span>'</span>  => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>-><span class="pl-c1">customer_name</span>, <span class="pl-c">// gateways rarely return these —</span>
        <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">email</span>'</span> => <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>order</span>-><span class="pl-c1">customer_email</span>,<span class="pl-c">// pass what your app knows</span>
    ])
    -><span class="pl-en">download</span>();                         <span class="pl-c">// → PDF download response</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="use Froshly\Parakit\Facades\Receipt;

$transaction = PaymentTransaction::where('reference', $order->id)->firstOrFail();

return Receipt::for($transaction)
    ->template('modern')                 // modern (default) · classic · minimal
    ->customer([
        'name'  => $order->customer_name, // gateways rarely return these —
        'email' => $order->customer_email,// pass what your app knows
    ])
    ->download();                         // → PDF download response" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto"><code>generate()</code> returns a receipt document you deliver however you like:</p>

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>pdf</span>-><span class="pl-en">download</span>();            <span class="pl-c">// attachment response</span>
<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>pdf</span>-><span class="pl-en">save</span>(<span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">s3</span>'</span>);            <span class="pl-c">// persist to a disk, returns the path</span>

<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Refund receipts</strong> — <code>Receipt::for($transaction)->asRefund()->generate()</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Templates</strong> — three production-grade designs, selectable per call or via
<code>parakit.receipts.template</code>. Publish them to customise:
<code>php artisan vendor:publish --tag=parakit-views</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Localised</strong> — renders in en / ar / ckb, RTL-aware, money formatted per
currency. Locale resolves from <code>->locale()</code>, transaction metadata, then config.</li>
<li><strong>Customer details</strong> — pass a <code>CustomerDetails</code> DTO or an array; anything you
omit falls back to the transaction's <code>metadata</code>.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">Each named config is fully isolated: its own circuit-breaker state, idempotency cache namespace, webhook route (<code>POST /payments/webhooks/fib_branch</code>), and <code>gateway</code> column in <code>payment_transactions</code>. Two configs sharing the same driver never bleed into each other.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Credentials in a database — <code>resolveMerchantUsing()</code></h3><a id="user-content-credentials-in-a-database--resolvemerchantusing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Credentials in a database — resolveMerchantUsing()" href="#credentials-in-a-database--resolvemerchantusing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">When merchants self-onboard and their credentials live in your database — not in <code>config/parakit.php</code> — register a resolver once in a service provider. Parakit calls it with the gateway name and expects the same config array shape as a static entry:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c">// app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php — boot()</span>
<span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">Froshly</span>\<span class="pl-v">Parakit</span>\<span class="pl-v">Facades</span>\<span class="pl-smi">Payment</span>;

Payment::<span class="pl-en">resolveMerchantUsing</span>(<span class="pl-k">function</span> (<span class="pl-smi">string</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>gateway</span>): <span class="pl-smi">array</span> {
    <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchant</span> = <span class="pl-en">app</span>(TenantManager::class)-><span class="pl-en">current</span>();

    <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>merchant</span>-><span class="pl-en">gatewayConfig</span>(<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>gateway</span>); <span class="pl-c">// ['driver' => 'fib', 'base_url' => ..., ...]</span>
});</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="// app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php — boot()
use Froshly\Parakit\Facades\Payment;

Payment::resolveMerchantUsing(function (string $gateway): array {
    $merchant = app(TenantManager::class)->current();

    return $merchant->gatewayConfig($gateway); // ['driver' => 'fib', 'base_url' => ..., ...]
});" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">After that, nothing else changes — <code>Payment::for($order)->driver('fib')->charge()</code> routes through your resolver. The resolver receives the gateway name, so one tenant can have any number of gateways (<code>fib</code>, <code>zaincash</code>, <code>fib_vip</code>, …), each resolved independently.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Store credentials <strong>encrypted</strong> (or as secret-manager references) and decrypt inside the resolver — don't keep raw secrets in plain DB columns.</p>
</blockquote>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Laravel Octane</h2><a id="user-content-laravel-octane" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Laravel Octane" href="#laravel-octane"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Parakit is Octane-safe out of the box — no extra setup, just run <code>octane:start</code>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Correlation IDs</strong> — <code>AssignCorrelationId</code> runs <code>CorrelationId::reset()</code> in its <code>terminate()</code> hook, so the per-request ULID is scrubbed from the container before the next request lands on the same worker.</li>
<li><strong>Resolved gateways</strong> — <code>PaymentManager</code> memoises instantiated drivers for the life of a request. Parakit flushes that cache automatically after every request (on <code>RequestHandled</code>, plus Octane's <code>RequestTerminated</code>), so a resolver returning per-tenant credentials never leaks one tenant's gateway into the next request on a reused worker.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">If you reconfigure gateways manually mid-request, you can still call <code>app('parakit.manager')->flushResolved()</code> yourself.</p>
<hr>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Security</h2><a id="user-content-security" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Security" href="#security"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="/ShahramMebashar/parakit/blob/main/SECURITY.md">SECURITY.md</a>. Shipped gateways either verify the provider's callback signature or re-fetch authoritative state server-to-server. TLS verification is enabled, and package-owned payloads are redacted before persistence by default.</p>
<p dir="auto">Report vulnerabilities privately via <strong>GitHub Security Advisories</strong> on this repository (<em>Security</em> tab → <em>Report a vulnerability</em>).</p>
